description: A subsection of the road link geometry that indicates where there is pavement on either side of the road

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

versiondate.description: Date when the version was last updated.

versionavailablefromdate.description: The date this version of the feature became the latest version.

versionavailabletodate.description: The date this version of the feature was superseded by an update or ceased to exist.

changetype.description: The type of change that generated a new version of the feature.
enum: Moved From A Different Feature Type
Moved To A Different Feature Type

geometry_length_m.description: The measured length of the geometry in metres.

theme.description: The OS NGD Theme to which the feature belongs.

description.description: A single descriptive value intended for a quick understanding of what the feature represents.

routehierarchy.description: A classification of the road designed to give the most appropriate route.

roadclassificationnumber.description: The official road number assigned by the appropriate authority, for example, M6.

name1_text.description: Name assigned to identify the feature.

name1_language.description: The language type associated with name1. The valid values are defined in the LanguageValue codelist.

name2_text.description: The alternative language name assigned to identify the feature.

name2_language.description: The language type associated with name2. The valid values are defined in the LanguageValue codelist.

alternatename1_text.description: Another name for the road that the feature is part of. This is populated with the name captured by Ordnance Survey when it differs from that in Street.

alternatename1_language.description: The language the name is expressed in, provided as a 3-digit ISO 639-2 code ('eng, 'cym', 'gla').

alternatename2_text.description: Another name for the road that the feature is part of. This is populated with the name captured by Ordnance Survey when it differs from that in Street.

alternatename2_language.description: The language the name is expressed in, provided as a 3-digit ISO 639-2 code ('eng, 'cym', 'gla').

capturespecification.description: Indicates the capture specification used by OS when capturing the feature. This could either be Urban, Rural or Moorland.

presenceofpavement_sideofroad.description: Indicates which side of the road the presence of pavement is located which can be both sides of a RoadLink.

presenceofpavement_minimumwidth_m.description: Indicates the minimum width of the pavement along a road link measured in metres.

presenceofpavement_averagewidth_m.description: Indicates the average width of the pavement along a road link measured in metres.

presenceofpavement_evidencedate.description: The date on which the latest evidence was gathered to make an update if required. For example the date of collection by a surveyor or third party information received.

presenceofpavement_updatedate.description: Date when the pavement presence was last updated.

presenceofpavement_source.description: Indicates the data source of the pavement presence.

presenceofpavement_capturemethod.description: The capture method describes how the pavement presence was created, for example, via remote survey or via an automated process.

roadlinkid.description: The unique identifier (OSID) of the RoadLink feature that the PavementLink is related to.
